items.explanation: Head noun là danh từ quan trọng nhất.

items.prompt: Noun phrase có main verb chia thì không?

options.text: Không — nó có thể chứa V-ing/V3 như participle bổ nghĩa

items.explanation: V-ing/V3 trong noun phrase là participle, không phải main verb.

items.prompt: Trong "the rapidly growing number of university students", head noun là gì?
"Students are dropping out of university." là gì?
items.explanation: "are dropping" là verb phrase chia thì → đây là clause.

items.prompt: Công thức cơ bản của noun phrase?
items.explanation: many + university + students + from rural areas.

exercises.title: Quy trình 4 bước Task 2
exercises.instruction: Sắp xếp 4 bước theo đúng thứ tự: VERB → NOUN → NOUN PHRASE → IELTS SENTENCE.

tokens: Xây noun phrase: the increasing use of private cars
Tìm verb chính: People use private cars.
Đưa vào câu: The increasing use of private cars has contributed to traffic congestion.
answer: Tìm verb chính: People use private cars.
Xây noun phrase: the increasing use of private cars
Đưa vào câu: The increasing use of private cars has contributed to traffic congestion.
items.explanation: VERB → NOUN → NOUN PHRASE → IELTS SENTENCE.

items.prompt: Với "More and more people are using social media.", cách paraphrase TỐT nhất là:

A lot of persons are utilising social media platforms

exercises.title: Viết câu IELTS từ noun phrase mục tiêu
exercises.instruction: Cho câu gốc và noun phrase mục tiêu, viết một câu IELTS Task 2 hoàn chỉnh (có mệnh đề chính, ý nghĩa academic). Làm cả 4 câu.

targetStructures: the increasing use of private cars
the growing number of students studying online
increased government investment in renewable energy
checklist: Câu 1: dùng "the increasing use of private cars" + hệ quả (traffic congestion)
Câu 2: dùng "the growing number of students studying online" + tác động
Câu 3: dùng "the growing dependence on smartphones" + tác động
Câu 4: dùng "increased government investment in renewable energy" + kết quả
Mỗi câu là một câu hoàn chỉnh, giữ nguyên meaning
rubric.sampleAnswer: The increasing use of private cars has contributed to traffic congestion in many major cities. The growing number of students studying online has changed the way higher education is delivered. The growing dependence on smartphones can reduce face-to-face interaction among young people. Increased government investment in renewable energy can accelerate the transition to cleaner power sources.

exercises.title: Sửa lỗi noun phrase trong câu Task 2
exercises.instruction: Mỗi câu có đúng một lỗi. Viết lại cả câu cho đúng.

items.prompt: The increasing use private cars causes congestion.
items.answer: The increasing use of private cars causes congestion.

items.prompt: The growing number of student living with parents is a concern.
items.answer: The growing number of students living with their parents is a concern.
items.explanation: Sau "the number of" phải là danh từ số nhiều.

items.prompt: The growing dependence of technology can be harmful.
items.answer: The growing dependence on technology can be harmful.

items.prompt: The rise of tuition fees has discouraged many applicants.
items.answer: The rise in tuition fees has discouraged many applicants.

items.prompt: The decision leave university early is often financial.
items.answer: The decision to leave university early is often financial.

items.prompt: The increasing number of people shopping online have changed retail.
items.answer: The increasing number of people shopping online has changed retail.

exercises.title: Paraphrase đề Task 2 bằng 3 noun phrase
exercises.instruction: Đề: "In several countries, a growing number of university students leave higher education before completing their degree. What are the causes and effects?" Viết 3 câu, mỗi câu dùng MỘT noun phrase khác nhau để nói về hiện tượng / nguyên nhân / hệ quả.

targetStructures: the failure to complete a degree
the financial burden of higher education
checklist: Mỗi câu dùng một noun phrase khác nhau (rate / failure / burden / pressure / opportunities…)
Giữ nguyên meaning: hiện tượng bỏ học đại học
Câu hoàn chỉnh, tự nhiên, đúng collocation
rubric.sampleAnswer: The increasing university dropout rate has become a growing concern in several countries. In many cases, the failure to complete a degree stems from the financial burden of higher education, which forces students to prioritise paid work. This trend also has social consequences, as limited employment opportunities after graduation can leave dropouts trapped in low-paid jobs.

exercises.title: Viết Introduction Task 2 bằng noun phrase
exercises.instruction: Viết một Introduction (2–3 câu) cho đề: "In several countries, a growing number of university students leave higher education before completing their degree program. What are the main causes of this trend, and what effects does it have on society?" Dùng ít nhất 2 pattern noun phrase và nêu rõ hai nhiệm vụ (causes + effects).

targetStructures: the increasing rate of university dropout
the growing number of university students
the decision to leave university prematurely
checklist: Paraphrase đề, KHÔNG chép nguyên văn
Dùng ít nhất 2 pattern noun phrase (rate / number of / decision to …)
Nêu rõ sẽ bàn cả nguyên nhân và hệ quả
Đúng thì hiện tại hoàn thành / hiện tại đơn cho xu hướng
rubric.sampleAnswer: In recent years, the increasing rate of university dropout has become a growing concern in several countries. A significant proportion of students now make the decision to leave higher education before completing their degree, raising questions about what lies behind this trend and how it affects wider society. This essay will examine the main causes of university non-completion and its consequences for both individuals and the community.
commonErrors: Nowadays, more and more students leave university… (chép ý đề, chưa nominalise)
the rate of university dropout are increasing
